name: Drakon
description: Drakon is the headline coaster of the new Valgard: Realm of the Vikings area, opened on 16 May 2026. It has a lift of about 23 m (75.5 ft) and two inversions. Min 125cm, or under 140cm with an adult.

name: Raven
description: Raven is a Gerstlauer bobsled coaster that opened in 2006 as Cobra and reopened as Raven in the Valgard area on 16 May 2026. It is about 17 m high. Min 110cm.

name: Vild Swing
description: Vild Swing is a swinging ride in the new Valgard area, opened on 16 May 2026, about 12 m high. Min 95cm.

name: Storm Chaser
description: Storm Chaser is a Mack spinning coaster in Tornado Springs that opened on 12 April 2021. It is about 20 m high. Min 100cm, age 4 and over.

name: Cyclonator
description: Cyclonator is a swinging thrill ride in Tornado Springs that opened in 2021, swinging riders up to about 25 m. Min 120cm, or 140cm to ride unaccompanied.

name: Flight of the Pterosaur
description: Flight of the Pterosaur is a family coaster in Lost Kingdom that opened on 17 May 2016. It is about 20 m high and reaches around 55 km/h. Min 100cm, age 4 and over.

name: Velociraptor
description: Velociraptor is a family coaster in Lost Kingdom that opened on 17 May 2016. It is about 20 m high and reaches around 58 km/h. Min 100cm, or 120cm to ride unaccompanied.

name: The Edge
description: The Edge is a thrill ride that opened in 2009. Min 120cm, age 6 and over.

name: Farmyard Flyer
description: Farmyard Flyer is a family ride in Tornado Springs that opened in 2022. Min 90cm.

name: Ghostly Manor
description: Ghostly Manor is an indoor interactive dark ride that opened in 2025. Check the height rule on the day.

name: Splash Lagoon
description: Splash Lagoon is a log flume in Lost Kingdom, opened in 2024. Check the height rule on the day.

name: Buffalo Falls
description: Buffalo Falls is a water ride in Tornado Springs with three drops. It first opened in 2003 and was moved in 2021. Min 90cm.

name: Grampy Rabbit's Sailing Club
description: Grampy Rabbit's Sailing Club is a gentle water ride in Peppa Pig World, opened in 2018. Check the height rule on the day.

name: Peppa's Big Balloon Ride
description: Peppa's Big Balloon Ride is a gentle family ride in Peppa Pig World, opened in 2011. Check the height rule on the day.

name: George's Dinosaur Adventure
description: George's Dinosaur Adventure is a family ride in Peppa Pig World, opened in 2011. Min 85cm.
